供 Apipost 导入的插件设置页与宿主通信接口，不包含 codex_run: Communication between the plugin settings page and the DSH host, suitable for import into Apipost. This specification does not cover the 15 model tools such as codex_run and does not describe an independent HTTP server. The plugin and DSH Connection Fetch must be enabled. All operations require DSH owner access. Replace the example server with the actual DSH Web base URL, including the port and deployment prefix, and configure a valid owner session Cookie. Cookie names depend on the host address; this specification models the complete Cookie header and does not introduce a plugin API key. Do not substitute Codex login credentials for a DSH session. For business errors returned with HTTP 200, inspect result.ok and result.error. All examples are synthetic and contain no real credentials, accounts, or local paths.

读取全部模型、支持的思考强度和服务档，以及注册表和本地化元数据。refresh=:
Read all models, supported reasoning efforts and service tiers, registry data, and localization metadata. refresh=true requests a new query; an expired cache may also trigger a refresh. This may start a read-only CLI query and update caches, but does not start a model turn. The response is the service catalog structure, which differs from the reduced output of the codex_models tool. Example models illustrate the format and are not evidence of availability for the current account.

Equivalent to the service call getCatalog({refresh:true}). The payload must be an empty object or omitted. If the native query fails, the operation can still succeed with a fallback catalog containing stale=true and an error. Inspect the value's source and error to assess freshness.

查询账号级额度和恢复状态: Read account-wide quota and recovery state
返回账号级 5 小时/7 天窗口、采样时间、告警、探测和恢复状态，不按工作区分配:
Return account-wide five-hour and seven-day quota windows, sample time, warning, probe, and recovery state. Quota is not allocated per workspace. fresh only queries the account API and does not start a model turn; refresh cannot bypass its three-minute rate limit. active reads active-run snapshots without sending messages. When no data is available, status=unknown; failed queries may retain older data.

只读取插件已知工作区中该运行保存的子任务状态，最多返回 32 项。运行归属、记录:
Read up to 32 saved subagent entries for a run in a workspace known to the plugin. If run ownership, records, or metadata are unavailable, the result has ok=true and value=null. This operation does not start subagents, read complete child messages, or cancel processes.

读取注册表编辑文档与修订号: Read the registry editor document and revision
读取合并后的字段规则、中文翻译、生成元数据、修订号及设置定义。配置值仍由 DSH:
Read merged field rules, Chinese translations, generated metadata, the revision, and setting definitions. Configuration values remain managed by DSH configForms. refresh=true rediscovers fields and updates reference caches; it is not merely a refresh of an in-memory draft. When readOnly=true, revision=null and saving is unavailable. The response example omits fields and uses a placeholder revision; never use it to replace the actual document.

预检或保存字段规则与中文翻译: Preview or save field rules and Chinese translations
先调用 getEditorRegistry，复制其完整 document 和 r:
Call getEditorRegistry first, copy its complete document and revision, then edit the required fields. The example only illustrates the structure: the all-zero revision and empty fields are placeholders and cannot be used directly for saving. The example uses preview=true for validation only; preview=false writes field overrides and user Chinese translations to fixed locations, without saving current profile settings. Preserve codexVersion and updatedAt unchanged. Omitted bundled fields are treated as disabled; reread the document if the revision is stale. The implementation attempts rollback if writing the rule or translation files fails. Preview returns configuration and definitions; saving returns a new complete editor view. This operation does not call a translation model.

HTTP 200 only means the envelope was processed. Check result.ok; business failures appear in result.error and do not automatically become HTTP 400 or 409. Send a client-request envelope, not the payload alone.
application/json；整个正文最多 1048576 个 JS 字符串: application/json; the complete body is limited to 1048576 JavaScript string code units. The serialized document is separately limited to 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes. The host may impose additional request body limits
需要宿主 connection、webServer、rpc.handle 及 r: Requires host connection, webServer, rpc.handle, and runEventStream support; the route is not registered if these are unavailable. The connection first receives a comment, then terminal-state invalidation notifications as data: JSON frames. This is not full progress output or a model token stream and does not use a server-response envelope. Each run emits one terminal event. There is no history replay or guaranteed Last-Event-ID recovery. The connection may remain open without any data frames; use a streaming client, since ordinary HTTP tests may time out. Only runs registered in the current process are observed; this operation does not start tasks
持续的 Server-Sent Events；每条 data 后有两个换行: Continuous Server-Sent Events; each data frame ends with two newline characters
填写已通过 DSH owner 登录的完整 Cookie 请求头值（name=v: Provide the complete Cookie header value of an authenticated DSH owner session (name=value; ...). Names depend on the host address and must not be hardcoded. This only models HTTP session transport; DSH Connection performs signature verification and owner authorization. Configure the value in a private Apipost environment, not in shared documentation
小写 UUID v4；rpcId 用于请求关联，响应原样返回。runId 使用相: Lowercase UUID v4; rpcId correlates requests and is echoed unchanged in responses. runId uses the same format

none 读取已有数据；fresh 查询账号；active 读取活动运行快照；b: none reads existing data; fresh queries the account; active reads active-run snapshots; both combines the latter two without sending steer messages

兼容规则；键为受校验的 Codex 字段名，不能借别名绕过权限控制: Compatibility rule keyed by a validated Codex field name; aliases cannot bypass permission controls
至多 200 字符的单行纯文本；不含尖括号、控制字符或换行: Single-line plain text of at most 200 characters; no angle brackets, control characters, or line breaks

用户中文翻译；空白值继承内置文本，保留原生 ID，不自动调用翻译模型: User Chinese translations; blank values inherit bundled text. Native IDs are preserved and no translation model is called automatically

系统生成的最后成功刷新时间，保存时必须保留原值: System-generated time of the last successful refresh; preserve the original value when saving
完整合并后的字段规则；不要以空对象替代读取结果: Complete merged field rules; do not replace the fetched result with an empty object
先读取当前文档，修改需要的字段后原样保留其余内容；省略内置字段会被解释为禁用该字: Read the current document first, edit only the required fields, and preserve all other content. Omitting a bundled field is treated as disabling it

true 仅预检，不写用户规则/翻译文件；false 才提交保存: true validates only and does not write user rule or translation files; false commits the save
